mapper.update: INSERT INTO compatibility_of_childcare_and_work (merge_key, number_of_paternity_leave, number_of_maternity_leave, paternity_leave_acquisition_num, maternity_leave_acquisition_num) VALUES (#{mergeKey}, #{numberOfPaternityLeave}, #{numberOfMaternityLeave}, #{paternityLeaveAcquisitionNum}, #{maternityLeaveAcquisitionNum}) ON CONFLICT (merge_key) DO UPDATE SET number_of_paternity_leave = EXCLUDED.number_of_paternity_leave, number_of_maternity_leave = EXCLUDED.number_of_maternity_leave, paternity_leave_acquisition_num = EXCLUDED.paternity_leave_acquisition_num, maternity_leave_acquisition_num = EXCLUDED.maternity_leave_acquisition_num WHERE ( compatibility_of_childcare_and_work.number_of_paternity_leave, compatibility_of_childcare_and_work.number_of_maternity_leave, compatibility_of_childcare_and_work.paternity_leave_acquisition_num, compatibility_of_childcare_and_work.maternity_leave_acquisition_num ) IS DISTINCT FROM ( EXCLUDED.number_of_paternity_leave, EXCLUDED.number_of_maternity_leave, EXCLUDED.paternity_leave_acquisition_num, EXCLUDED.maternity_leave_acquisition_num )
